# Full-year walk-forward market-maker ladder (generated by market/full_year.py; do not edit by hand)

Real Kalshi taker trades replayed against LMSR makers in 7 cities, 2025-08-14 to 2026-08-13. Test months 2025-10 to 2026-08: each month's settings are fit on every eligible earlier day whose high was final at that month's first quote. 1,990 test city-days. Daily PnL in dollars for one six-bin event; a counterfactual estimate, not realized PnL.

Days replayed (trade flow after the cutoff) / strict days (also >= 80% one-minute coverage and an official high, used to fit the sensor margin), out of all days with a forecast and a quote: NYC 352/198/352, LAX 350/113/350, CHI 351/228/351, MIA 351/188/351, AUS 352/106/352, DEN 352/257/352, PHL 352/201/352.

## 1. What each idea adds (same settings for every maker)

Each month every maker uses the forecast maker's walk-forward b and fee, so a difference comes from the idea alone. Mean test-day PnL gain per city; pooled = each city's daily gaps divided by their own standard deviation, then all city-days resampled.

## Caveats

- Replay: a real trade fills only if the maker would have been at least as good, at the taker's own price. Trades the maker would have attracted but Kalshi did not are missing, and traders might have reacted to these quotes.
- Live makers act on the 1-minute reading from 5 minutes earlier, standing in for the public feed.
- Every setting is chosen from earlier days only, but the grids, the walk-forward rule and the maker list were fixed after seeing the six-city results, so this is a stronger out-of-sample check, not a blind one.
- Fees are a hypothetical maker charge, not Kalshi's fee schedule.
